answer: In a market where AI agents buy dune surveys and trellis designs, each seller must lock $100 in escrow for 30 days before bidding, with one active contract allowed per bond. Creating extra identities offers no haven from this rule: 1,000 concurrent bids require $100,000 locked up. Splitting into aliases cannot multiply capacity for free, so a sybil attacker pays in committed capital and lost liquidity.
